sentences.text: Hardness crept up to 240 ppm overnight — someone check whether the crushed coral bag split. Dim lights keep the wild bettas calm, so we work by headlamp when netting out pairs. Nobody warned me that angelfish eat their first three clutches before figuring out parenthood. I mark each spawning jar's lid with tape: date, pair number, hardness at laying. Eggs stuck to the heater cord again, which means scraping and praying half survive the move. He logs GH and KH in a spiral notebook, one column per shelf, dated in pencil. Every runt gets fed to the bichir; sentiment doesn't pay for fish food. Her ledger shows which pairings threw long fins and which threw nothing worth keeping. Fry from batch eleven took powdered egg yolk at dawn and again at three. Records indicate the corydoras deposited eggs on the glass within six hours of the cool-water change. Water changes happen Sundays: twenty percent for growouts, ten for anything still at wriggler stage. Wrigglers clung to the slate for two days before lifting off in one silver cloud. At 6.4 pH the rams finally spawned, after months of stubborn refusal at 7.2. The kribensis pair claimed the coconut cave again, fanning eggs before the lights even warmed up. A siphon hose, a brine shrimp hatchery, and a bucket of aged water — my whole morning, basically. Conditioning took two weeks of blackworms before the female finally plumped up enough to set. Do buyers ever ask about the culls? Never — they only want the show-quality males. Along all four shelves the sponge filters gurgle softly, a sound she stopped hearing years ago. Check the spawning mop tomorrow; the ricefish were chasing hard through it all afternoon. Under the dim red bulb, the pleco female stayed wedged in her cave for nine days straight. What is the meaning of the word tank?
